# Streaming-host native-unit fixture

These three units preserve the approved three-unit Sunshine authority shape for parser and approval-report tests. They cover a KMS Sunshine service, a private sequential-packet socket, and the root input-seat receiver.

The fixture uses immutable test store paths so Rust tests can run without building Sunshine. The package under `plugins/sunshine/` in `korri-os/plugins` is the production source. Its package build and seed check prove that the generated native artifacts pass the same admission path.
